correctness.rationale: The smooth locus has exactly seven allowed base-field coefficients and thus 42 ordered distinct pairs. Explicit Klein-four involutions give three genus-one quotients defined over F9; character decomposition of H^1 gives the product of their Weil polynomials. All 21 unordered pairs are present in spectrum_21.csv, and every quotient trace is computed from nine exact quadratic-character evaluations. Two independently implemented F9 models agree on all five trace-multiset counts, and the second independently counts all 42 curves over F9, F81, F729, which suffices to determine every degree-six Weil polynomial using the genus-three functional equation. Both actual programs terminated successfully.

value.rationale: The complete Hasse-Weil numerator is a natural arithmetic invariant controlling every extension-field point count and the Jacobian F9 isogeny class. F9 is the smallest characteristic-three field with any smooth ordered pair in this normalized Howe family. The five-type exact classification distinguishes different Weil spectra inside each known p-rank stratum, and the 20-point maximum is sharp over the complete marked family, not an arbitrary sample. The 21-row certificate gives a reproducible arithmetic benchmark for quotient decompositions, while carefully avoiding broader or unsupported implications.
